name: JetZero
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: JetZero is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: JetZero is a privately held aerospace company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $175 million Series B round announced on January 13, 2026, was led by B Capital, and the company did not disclose a valuation.

Founded in 2020 and based in Long Beach, California, JetZero is designing the Z4, a blended-wing-body airliner intended to burn less fuel than conventional tube-and-wing aircraft. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: JetZero has not disclosed a valuation for either round or the size of the Series A. Alaska Airlines said in August 2024 that it had invested in the Series A the previous year.
round_notes: JetZero has said that, including government grants, incentives and commercial commitments, it has raised and secured more than $1 billion; that figure is the company's own and is not equity alone. In August 2026, the company closed a senior secured term loan facility of up to $100 million led by Pinegrove Credit Partners and Silicon Valley Bank, which is debt and is not shown in the table.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: B Capital led the Series B, with participation from United Airlines Ventures, Northrop Grumman, 3M Ventures, Trucks VC, Marlinspike, Aero X Ventures and RTX Ventures. Alaska Airlines invested in the Series A through its venture arm, Alaska Star Ventures.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming JetZero appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: JetZero's announcements of its Series B (January 13, 2026) and its term loan facility (August 31, 2026); Alaska Airlines' announcement of its investment (August 13, 2024); a report by AIN (January 2026); and SEC Form D filings.
